unlisted_practices: Development of a multimodal conversational model for post-stroke language rehabilitation, evaluated on speech recognition, speech translation, and an adjusted MME benchmark

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates a multimodal generative conversational model (combining ImageBind-LLM and BlenderBot) for post-stroke language disorder rehabilitation using benchmark datasets (NINDS, MSDM, and clinical audio/video data) on ASR, AST, and MME tasks without testing a deployment practice.
